title.zh: 蓝绿空间与 NDVI 指标方法说明
title.en: Blue-Green Space and NDVI Indicator Methodology

zh: 面积、覆盖率、平均 NDVI 与人口加权 NDVI 回答不同问题，不可互相替代。
可获得、口径明确且通过质量控制的原始统计均正式入库，综合指数筛选与权重另行版本化。
物理值与行政值使用同源、同年、同算法分别计算，独立保存。
缺失不等于零；无数据、不适用与真实零值必须区分。
en: Area, coverage, mean NDVI and population-weighted NDVI answer distinct questions and are not interchangeable.
Available, well-defined and quality-controlled statistics enter the indicator database; composite-index selection and weights are versioned separately.
Physical and administrative results use the same source, year and algorithm and remain separate outputs.
Missing is not zero; no data, not applicable and observed zero must be distinguished.

formulas: 陆地面积（LAND_AREA_KM2_2021）= 城市边界面积 − 永久水体面积。绿地、树木、灌木与草地覆盖率的统一分母为陆地面积；永久水体覆盖率的分母为城市边界总面积。面积与百分比均作为正式指标入库，分别描述绝对规模和相对规模。
sources: MODIS 250 m 尺度可能平滑小型城市和狭窄绿地；跨气候区比较仍受物候和云污染影响。
JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 — Yearly History: https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JRC_GSW1_4_YearlyHistory
